video_title: Has Sam Presti and the Thunder LOST THEIR MINDS 🤯

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating if OKC should move Chet Holmgren
quotes.excerpt: Chet Holmgren is not going nowhere.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: All y'all can shut the hell up. Chet Holmgren is not going nowhere.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Oh, he is wildin'.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Come on now.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: CV, talk about it.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: No, you got to go because, yo, Victor Wembanyama ain't going nowhere, fam. This matchup is going to be for the foreseeable future.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on keeping Chet Holmgren over Hartenstein
quotes.excerpt: I am keeping Chet over Hartenstein. If I can get Chet with Giannis, I like that better.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I am keeping Chet over Isaiah Hartenstein. If I can get Chet with Giannis Antetokounmpo and I can put Giannis at that four spot, I like that better than trying to, you feel me? I like that better.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I agree with that.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the development potential of Victor Wembanyama and Chet Holmgren
quotes.excerpt: Who you got more trajectory of getting better, Victor Wembanyama or Chet Holmgren?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Who you got more trajectory of getting better, Victor Wembanyama or Chet Holmgren?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: That is not what I am arguing. I don't think Chet will ever be who Victor Wembanyama is, but he can get better and it can be a battle.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan's perspective on LeBron James

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: DeMar DeRozan talked about LeBron James. He said there is just somebody I just can't fucking beat.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: That is Victor Wembanyama for Chet.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the roles of DeMar DeRozan and Chet Holmgren
quotes.excerpt: DeMar was supposed to be the number one on the Raptors. Shai is the number one.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: DeMar was supposed to be the number one on the Raptors. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is the number one. So Chet is just a role player. He is playing his part.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Offensively, he is third.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Is Chet Holmgren intimidated by Victor Wembanyama?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Do you believe Chet is scared of Victor Wembanyama?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I do believe that.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren's competitive nature
quotes.excerpt: One thing about Chet was he was always a competitor.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: One thing about Chet was he was always a competitor. So you don't think he can go into the lab, work on shit, give more confident, come back better?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: There is not a better, like, Chet matches up with Victor Wembanyama for sure.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Presti's roster management and the Thunder's playoff run
quotes.excerpt: There is no excuses. Sam Presti and the Thunder won. They had two players out.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: There is no excuses. Sam Presti and the Thunder won. They had two players out. Still went to Game 7.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: It still went to Game 7. It wasn't like they just got throttled.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating if MVP is representative of the best player
quotes.excerpt: I don't think the MVP is always representative of the best player in the world.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I don't think the MVP is always representative of the best player in the world. But until Victor Wembanyama wins it all, I don't think you can claim someone the best player in the world if they haven't climbed the mountain top.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: You got to climb the mountain top to be the best.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Presti's roster decisions and the future of the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: Sam Presti is in the driver's seat. He is still the best team in the league.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Sam Presti is in the driver's seat. He is still the best team in the league this year, record-wise. He just got MVP back-to-back. He did make it to the Western Conference finals and lost in Game 7.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: And Jalen Williams didn't even play that well.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The rivalry between the Thunder and the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: These are the two teams that is going to be looked at on a pedestal.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: These are the two teams that is going to be looked at on a pedestal every year for the next five years. San Antonio and OKC. Those two teams are going to be battling every year on who is the best.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: It is a legit rivalry.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of injuries on the Thunder's playoff performance
quotes.excerpt: You take away De'Aaron Fox and P.J. Washington, who you got to be a playmaker?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You take away De'Aaron Fox and P.J. Washington, who you got to be a playmaker? You got shooters over there, but you take away playmakers. And I said that, but you know, still, like they say, next man up.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: They still took them to seven.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's loyalty to Lu Dort
quotes.excerpt: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander will make it apparent to Sam Presti that he doesn't want Lu Dort moved.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander will make it apparent to Sam Presti that he doesn't want Lu Dort moved under any circumstance this summer.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: That is good shit.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Presti's commitment to the Thunder's core
quotes.excerpt: I can understand the point of view where Sam Presti would want to keep this team together.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I can understand the point of view where Sam Presti would want to keep this team together and bet on a player he drafted and has been five years together. I want to keep Chet with Giannis Antetokounmpo.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I don't think you understand what I am saying.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Hypothetical trade involving the Thunder and the Bucks
quotes.excerpt: Do they swap Jalen Williams, Isaiah Hartenstein and Chet for Miles Bridges and Giannis Antetokounmpo?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Do they swap Jalen Williams, Isaiah Hartenstein and Chet for Miles Bridges and Giannis Antetokounmpo? Because I feel like Miles Bridges could fit with them as well.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Yes, I would do it in a heartbeat.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his business ventures in Milwaukee
quotes.excerpt: They reached out to me, they said that they want to open like a restaurant here.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: They reached out to me, they said that they want to open like a restaurant here in Milwaukee because I am Greek. And I was like, oh, lovely! You know, I will be able to, after the games, I come eat here, enjoy Mediterranean cuisine and have a little bit of privacy and stuff.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his upbringing and career in Milwaukee
quotes.excerpt: I was born and raised in Athens. I was there until 18. My parents came from Nigeria.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I was born and raised in Athens. I was there until 18. My parents came from Nigeria in 1991. They had my older brother, Thanasis Antetokounmpo. I wish he was here because he is so business-savvy, too. 2013, I got drafted, I came here in Milwaukee. I have been here for 13 years with the team and hopefully many more.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson's reaction to Giannis Antetokounmpo's comments
quotes.excerpt: He is sick of him talking about staying in Milwaukee.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: He is sick of him talking about staying in Milwaukee.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I don't got nothing to say about that shit, bro. We know that nigga leaving, bro.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Giannis Antetokounmpo's future
quotes.excerpt: He never said he wants out if we are not going to win.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: He never said he wants out if we are not going to win if y'all are not going to make the changes to bring the right people over here to play with me. And if you are not, then yes, I want to leave. But Giannis will stay in Milwaukee. Yes, he will.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Because he likes the place he plays.
